blocks.text: A table names the facts each row can hold. An identity column can create a new numeric id automatically.
Use PostgreSQL in a new practice database through psql or a database editor. These are PostgreSQL examples, not SQLite. They do not run in this site's SQL playground. Use only sample data.

blocks.title: Make a practice table

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: A primary key identifies a row and prevents duplicate key values. Related records can refer to that key.
`NOT NULL` requires a value to be present. It is a separate rule from numeric range checks.

blocks.text: A temporary book table exists for the current database session. Each new row must have a title and a positive page count.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Run the table creation once per session. Temporary tables disappear when that session ends.

blocks.text: Explain which rule prevents a negative page count.
